name: Ari Lerner
summary: Systems engineering leader building secure execution infrastructure, distributed systems, and AI platforms in Rust and AWS. Architected banking infrastructure serving 100K+ customers and led a 7-person platform replacement while maintaining 99.9% uptime. Founder of MVM, focused on hardware-isolated execution of AI agents and untrusted code; previously built production AI/ML systems at AWS and scaled newline.io to $2M+ annual revenue.

skills.label: Security and AI
skills.text: AI-agent isolation, threat modeling, identity and access management, audit logging, signed execution plans, SOC 2, machine learning systems

highlights.text: Isolated AI agents and untrusted code in MVM microVMs with separate guest kernels and host-mediated, default-deny network access.
18 security claims tied to executable CI checks, covering signed execution plans, tamper-evident audit logs, verified boot, and sealed production images.
highlights.review_note: Confirm the current claim count and the exact guarantees each test establishes. CI coverage is not proof of all possible behaviors.

highlights.text: Kept raw credentials outside guest workloads through vsock secret substitution and PII redaction, including detection across frame boundaries.
highlights.review_note: Validate scope and adversarial test coverage; this is the source resume's architecture claim, not an independent security audit.

highlights.text: Bound AI-agent execution to per-run capability grants so model-generated code could run without granting unrestricted authority.
highlights.review_note: Useful for a security-specific role; overlaps the first MVM bullet.

highlights.text: Enabled real-time youth-sports tracking through RoboRef computer vision, autonomous camera control, and low-latency edge inference.

highlights.text: Enabled content-addressed compute reuse and constant-time lookup for finite-domain functions as co-inventor of a holographic computing method.
highlights.review_note: Source lists provisional application 63/976,830, filed February 2026. Confirm filing details and current status. The reported ~28x result concerns bf16 GELU, not end-to-end inference.

highlights.text: Enabled experimental multiplication-free inference by cross-compiling transformer models into artifacts using add, shift, XOR, compare, and table-read operations.
highlights.review_note: No claim of production readiness or equivalent model quality. Restore 28.1x compression or certified residual only with artifact sizes, definitions, quality evaluation, and reproducible evidence.

cover_letter_paragraphs: Your team needs infrastructure that lets AI products move quickly without compromising security, reliability, or operational control. I build the systems that make that possible.

At Herring Bank, I architected a cloud-native banking platform serving 100K+ customers and led a seven-person team replacing an end-of-life core while maintaining 99.9% uptime. At AWS, I built distributed machine-learning infrastructure. Today, I am building MVM, which isolates AI agents and untrusted code in microVMs with signed execution plans and auditable controls.

I bring hands-on Rust engineering, production platform experience, and the judgment to connect architecture with business outcomes. I would welcome a focused technical conversation about your most pressing infrastructure challenges and how I would approach them as your next Principal Software Engineer.
